coding_context.reported_success_quote:
Using a binomial test as my key analysis of interest, I found that U.S. adults were more likely to match based on shape overall, but that this result depended on the exemplar shape, since I replicated the results in the original paper for the arch and lamp exemplars that the probability of success was greater than 1/3 , respectively, but not for the snowman exemplar 
.

prior_adjudication.reason: In Experiment 5, 68.75% of the 144 single-trial U.S. adult participants chose the shape match, which is an exact reproducible transformation to the shipped proportion 99/144 (0.6875 * 144 = 99).
